full_judgment:
6. It is also the case of the prosecution that Loco Foreman Paul Khan and Fuel Clerk, Syed Ali Mondal dishonestly did not account for the said 11000 galons of superior kerosene oil in the records of Santahar Locoshed. It is also the case of the prosecution that consignee Mr. Abdur Rahman of Rahmat Bhander then filed a claim petition for Taka 1,30,000.00 for non-receipt of the consignment. Over that matter an Enquiry Committee was constituted and the Committee after necessary enquiry submitted its report and on the basis of that report the CCM (C), Bangladesh Railway, Chiuagong asked the Divisional Mechanical Engineer, Paksey on 3.3.76 for directing the LF Santahar to return 11000 gallons of superior kerosene oil to the consignee which he unloaded illegally to his storage tank. Absconding accused Abul Kashem, the Divisional Mechanical Engineer, Paksey then under his letter dated 22.3.76 asked the Fuel Inspector, Khulna to book one BTO with 11000 gallons of HSD oil to LF, Santahar and directed the loco Foreman, Santahar to make over the said BTO to Traffic Department, Santahar for sending it to Phulbari in favour of M/s. Rahmat Bhandcr and accordingly Fuel Inspector, Khulna booked 11000 gallons of HSD oil in BTO No. 40058 RMC No. 04361 dated 3.4.1976 in favour of Loco Foreman, Santahar. Absconding accused Paul Khan who was the Loco Foreman, Santahar and Syed Ali Mondal, Fuel Clerk then showed receipt of the contents of this BTO No. 40055 and the former BTO. No. 40058 in their records on 6.4.76 and made over BTO No. 40055 containing 11000 gallons of HSD oil to the Traffic Department for giving delivery of the same to the said actual consignee. Mr. Azahar Ali, the Chief Claims Inspector then received that BTO on 8.4.76 and delivered the goods to Rahmat Bhander, Phulbari the consignee of BTO No. 40058. 

 13. The next witness is PW 2 Abdul Latif who was Assistant Mechanical Engineer, Paksey in 1975. He deposed that by way of RR No. 622309, 11000 gallons of kerosene oil were despatched to Phulbari Railay Station from Khulna by wagon No. 40058 and when the consignment failed to reach Phulbari, the consignee made a complaint over which he himself held an enquiry. He deposed during enquiry it transpired that the said wagon reached Santahar on 8.12.75 and there was an order from Santahar Railway Station Authority to attach the wagon with 765 Up train for sending it to Phulbari Railway Station, but the same was not done. He deposed that the said wagon was lying at Santahar Railway Yard from 8.12.75 to 10.12.75. He also stated that someone removed the label card from the wagon and for that Santahar Railway Traffic marked the wagon to locoshed. The wagon was sent to the locoshed and on 15.12.75 the consignee met him and he then went to Santahar but found no trace of the wagon. This witness also deposed that till 11.12.75 the wagon was in the shed. He also deposed that the loaded wagon was sent to the shed either by mistake or intentionally. He admitted that only the oil meant for the Railway are stored in the locoshed. He also admitted that the employees and the officers of the Locoshed unloaded the wagon and kept the oil in the storage tank and after taking the measurement he found 7,361 gallons of oil in excess. He further deposed that had the unloading being done through mistake there would have been 11000 gallons of oil in the tank. This witness then submitted his enquiry report marked Ext. 29. This PW 2 was thoroughly cross-examined by the defence and during cross-examination he admitted that he was directed by the Chief Commercial Manager to hold the enquiry. He further admitted that no one from the Jamuna Oil Company told him that they dispatched 11000 gallons of oil. He denied the defence suggestion that the questioned oil was not booked. 

 24. The definite allegation against this appellant Syed Ali Mondal is that he as Fuel Clerk of Locoshed at Santahar did not account for 11000 gallons of superior kerosene oil in the record of Locoshed, Santahar which was unloaded in the shed. From the materials on record it appears that absconding accused Abul Kashem, the then Divisional Mechanical Engineer, Paksey under his order dated 22.3.76 asked Fuel Inspector, Khulna to book one BTO loaded with 11000 gallons of HSD oil to LF Santahar and directed the Loco Foreman, Santahar to make over the said BTO to Traffic Department, Santahar for sending it to Phulbari in favour of Rahmat Bhander and accordingly the Fuel Inspector, Khulna booked 11000 gallons of HSD oil BTO No. 40055 vide RMC No. 046361 dated 3.4.76 in favour of LF Santahar. It appears that this appellant Syed Ali Mondal and absconding accused Paul Khan showed receipt of this BTO No. 40055 and former BTO No. 40058 in their records on 6.4.76 and made over BTO No. 40055 containing 11000 gallons of HSD oil to the Traffic Department for delivery of the same to the actual consignee M/s. Rahmat Bhander, Phulbari. It appears that Chief Claim Inspector received the BTO on 8.4.76 and gave delivery of it to Mis. Rahmat Bhander, Phulbari, the consignee of BTO No. 40058. So, from the perusal of the record it appears that appellant Syed Ali Mondal, Fuel Clerk after receipt of BTO No. 40055 showed it in his record and thereafter made over the wagon to Chief Claims Inspector for delivery to the actual consignee of ETO No. 40058 and in the process there was shortage of 4139 gallons of HSD oil in the locoshed. 

 26. As regards the complicity of appellant Syed Ali Mondal, it appears that he maintained the Fuel Register as Fuel Clerk of the locoshed and he showed the receipt of the contents of BTO No. 40055 and BTO No. 40058 in the record on 6.4.76 and made over BTO No. 40055 containing 11000 gallons of HSD to the Chief Claims Inspector for onward delivery to M/s. Rahrnat Bhander. From Ext 29 which is an enquiry report it appears that a wrong statement was submitted on the contents in the storage tank in the locoshed and admittedly absconding accused Paul Khan was the Loco Foreman and in-charge of the storage tanks and this Syed Ali Mondal was the clerk of that shed and he also showed less quantity in the tank in his register and his acts and activities indicate that he abetted the misappropriation of 4139 gallons of HSD oil. His acts cannot be construed as an act of negligence. On receipt of BTO No. 40058 the same was unloaded and then empty wagon was returned but afterwards on the orders of absconding accused Abul Kashem, the Divisional Mechanical Engineer, Paksey the Loco Foreman, Santahar booked 11000 gallons of HSD oil in BTO No. 40055 which was ultimately handed over to the real consignee of BTO No. 40058 and the Enquiry Committee on proper and physical verification of the storage tanks found shortage of 4139 gallons of HSD oil with which previously 11000 gallons of superior kerosene oil was mixed up. So, on consideration of the evidence on record and the facts and circumstances of the case I hold that this appellant Syed Ali Mondal had some hand in the misappropriation and he aided and abetted the offence and he has been rightly found guilty by the trial Court and there is nothing to interfere with the same.
